opinions.text: I agree with the refund but think the apology is unnecessary. RBI timelines for failed ATM transactions say refunds must be credited within a fixed number of days, so the bank should also pay compensation for the delay.

comments.text: Good point on compensation. Please cite the exact RBI circular and the day count before relying on it.

opinions.text: The AI is right to ask for the respondent version first. I would also check whether the demand notice was sent within the time limit, since that affects whether the cheque route is open.

comments.text: Agreed. Timing of the notice is the first thing I would verify.

opinions.text: Proposal looks fair. I suggest adding that any deduction must be itemised and agreed in writing, to avoid the same dispute again.
